title: Humulus lupulus cream for medicinal use
intro: Humulus lupulus cream is a topical preparation made from the dried flowers of the hop plant, Humulus lupulus. It is commonly used in herbalism for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The cream is applied to the skin to relieve muscle pain, joint inflammation, and skin irritations. It is often used in the treatment of conditions such as arthritis and muscle strains. Due to its soothing effects, it is also used to calm skin conditions like eczema and psoriasis.
